Our ultimate goal is providing our patients and clients with quality service and care they deserve. We are dedicated in providing responsive, timely customer service. about:
Premier Hospital Supply & O2 Solutions operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a division of Premier Hospital Supply focused on respiratory care and durable medical equipment. The company serves patients and hospitals across the state, providing equipment and clinical support for sleep apnea and oxygen therapy.

The business supplies a range of positive airway pressure devices — including CPAP, VPAP, and APAP units — along with nasal, pillow, and full-face masks. For home oxygen therapy, it offers portable oxygen concentrators, stationary concentrators, oxygen cylinders, and nebulizers. A respiratory therapist meets with each referred patient to review the sleep study, demonstrate equipment use, explain insurance benefits, and handle billing.

Customers are primarily individuals referred by sleep physicians after a sleep study, as well as hospitals throughout New Mexico that require respiratory equipment and compliance support. The company coordinates directly with prescribing doctors and insurance carriers to qualify patients and deliver the prescribed devices.

The organization states its mission is to set standards of excellence in respiratory care, emphasizing responsive customer service and education for both staff and patients to achieve 100 percent compliance and satisfaction.
